## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make lint-ruff
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make format-check
- [ ] KNOWN-ISSUES.md contains a section on the dual-identity invariant's two failure modes
  Verify: grep -q 'dual-identity invariant' .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md
- [ ] KNOWN-ISSUES.md documents quarantine suppression semantics
  Verify: grep -q 'quarantine' .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md
- [ ] KNOWN-ISSUES.md documents the repair_property failure operator-visible behavior (label removal + dedup_key bridge-alert:schema-drift)
  Verify: grep -q 'bridge-alert:schema-drift' .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md
- [ ] Story id 7a75-53f5-ba82-44cd referenced
  Verify: grep -F '7a75-53f5-ba82-44cd' .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md

## Implementation Notes
Append a subsection to .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md covering:
1. Dual-identity invariant: scans Jira for (a) property missing but label present → quarantine + bug; (b) property present but label missing → bug ticket same pass.
2. Quarantine suppression: once an issue is quarantined in a pass, all other mutations for that issue are suppressed from the manifest. Differ enforces via _emit() helper; reconcile.py enforces via post-emit filter (belt-and-suspenders).
3. repair_property failure: applier removes the orphan dso-id-<local_id> label AND files a quarantine bug via dedup_key 'bridge-alert:schema-drift:<issue_key>' — same pass.
4. Reference story 7a75-53f5-ba82-44cd.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

AC amendment (gap G10): T5 docs scope. T5 currently depends on T1 only for parallel-dispatch. The docs MUST cover behavior contributed by T2/T3/T4 (quarantine suppression, repair_property failure path). Two options:
1. Bump T5 deps to {T1, T2, T3, T4} — sequential, accurate.
2. Restrict T5 scope to ONLY the T1 invariant + Mode A/B taxonomy; defer applier/differ docs to a follow-up.
Recommend option 1 for completeness — the docs are operator-facing and must describe what they'll actually see in production. Story closure should re-link T5 → T4 if option 1 is taken.
